model.name: Human Risk Maturity
model.description: H.1 — a dedicated, cmdash-authored maturity ladder for the human element of security: phishing-simulation resilience and security-awareness-training discipline. Deliberately a single-dimension model kept separate from NIST CSF 2's broader 'Protect' bucket so a tenant's human-risk posture is independently drillable to its own observations, freshness, and business-unit rollup rather than blended into a coarser control family. The dimension maps to NIST CSF 2's PR.AT (Awareness and Training) category so both an attested crosswalk baseline (via ControlAssessment on PR.AT-01/PR.AT-02) and live telemetry (KnowBe4 / Proofpoint Security Awareness Training MaturityObservations, observationType=HUMAN_RISK) can seed and score the same dimension. See docs/design/telemetry-scoring.md §1 (H.1) for the observation contract this pack's telemetry side rides on.

levels.name: Ad Hoc
levels.description: No recurring phishing-simulation program and no tracked security-awareness-training completion. Any awareness activity is one-off, unmeasured, and not reviewed by anyone accountable for the outcome.

levels.name: Programmatic
levels.description: A recurring phishing-simulation cadence and mandatory annual/onboarding awareness training exist tenant-wide, but results are not broken out by business unit, repeat-clicker behavior isn't tracked, and there is no defined escalation when a unit under-performs.

levels.name: Managed
levels.description: Phishing fail rate, repeat-clicker ratio, and training completion are tracked continuously and reviewed per business unit (subject to a minimum-group-size privacy floor); under-performing units trigger a targeted awareness-policy attestation campaign through the existing policy-attestation workflow rather than an ad hoc email.

levels.name: Adaptive
levels.description: Training content and simulation difficulty are tuned from measured risk data (e.g. targeting repeat clickers with role-appropriate refreshers), completion time and fail-rate trends are reviewed on a fixed cadence by an accountable owner, and the program demonstrably closes the loop from signal to remediation to re-measurement.

dimensions.name: Human Risk & Security Awareness
dimensions.description: Composite of phishing-simulation fail rate, repeat-clicker ratio, security-awareness-training completion rate, and time-to-complete — the four H.1 metrics normalized by the shared `normalizeObservation` curve (packages/shared/src/maturity/telemetry.ts, observationType=HUMAN_RISK) and rolled up tenant-wide and per-business-unit (k-anonymity gated — see apps/api/src/human-risk/human-risk.service.ts).
